subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should maintainers keep this umbrella open until the focused Anthropic completed-turn replay prevention PR lands, or close it in favor of the narrower prevention issue now that the recovery carrier fixes are on main?
rationale: The raw-error and async recovery defects are fixed, but the remaining work changes provider replay behavior for signed thinking blocks and has compatibility tradeoffs that automation should not choose silently.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Prevention Lands
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers review and land or reject the focused replay-prevention PR, then close with commit and release provenance.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 as the remaining prevention tracker.

options.title: Declare Recovery Sufficient
options.body: Treat the merged recovery fixes as enough for this umbrella and accept that future prevention reports will be handled only in narrower issues.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Prevention Lands
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers review and land or reject the focused replay-prevention PR, then close with commit and release provenance.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed the split between landed recovery work and remaining creation/prevention work in the issue discussion.
